SYN-MOD-EV2-001:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER width = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER height = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
DISPLAYNL(width * height).

SYN-MOD-LP1-001:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total = 0.
LOOP (NUMBER i = 1 TILL i <= n, i++) {

}
DISPLAYNL(total).

SYN-MOD-CP1-001:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER base = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER exponent = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER result = 1.
LOOP (NUMBER i = 0 TILL i < exponent, i++) {
    result *= base.
}
DISPLAYNL(result).
